thesis: The world can contradict our explanations, which must risk being wrong.
role: Introduce the distinction between anomalies, interpretations and invented causes.

ideas.statement: A reproducible anomaly establishes a mismatch between measurements and model, not automatically changed laws or a simulated update.
Laws enable prediction but can also make contingent arrangements appear inevitable.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The clock laboratory is an imaginary thought experiment.
